usageNotes: Call this endpoint to complete the OpenID Connect authorization code flow and obtain a PDM session ticket. The caller must supply the authorization code, state, and redirect URL exactly as returned by the identity provider and used in the initial authorization request — any mismatch will result in rejection. The response sets an HttpOnly session cookie; subsequent API calls should present the CSRFPreventionToken header alongside the cookie to satisfy CSRF protection.

examples.summary: Exchange an OpenID authorization code for a PDM session ticket

tips: The redirect-url must exactly match the value registered with the OpenID provider; even a trailing-slash difference will cause the token exchange to fail.
On success, the real ticket is delivered as an HttpOnly cookie (not in the JSON body); the response body's ticket-info field contains an unsigned version useful only for client-side display.
Store the CSRFPreventionToken from the response and send it as the CSRFPreventionToken header on all subsequent write requests.
This endpoint requires no prior authentication (permissions: world), making it safe to call before any session exists.
